title: Generation Trace Audit: API calls and compiler stages become inspectable

ciFast.note: Fast verification is claimed only after v0.15.85 is pushed and the GitHub Actions run is attached.

deploy.note: Pages deploy is not claimed until the pushed release completes its deploy run.

ciDeep.note: This is a narrow observability/runtime/report-truth release; focused regressions plus normal gates are the release bar.

liveProvider.note: The release is based on local implementation proof and the v0.15.84 User Experience Design Studio ZIP/log audit, whose patched local regrade is 93/A with six P1 source-ledger false-friend findings. A fresh deployed v0.15.85 package audit is required to verify the new trace rows and source quarantine in provider logs.

manualHuman.note: No external instructor approval is claimed by this release.

claims.summary: Default API trace rows now carry run id, stage, provider/model, feature, counters, cost plan, usage summary, failure metadata, and compiler savings without prompt or key material.
Provider streaming now emits request-start and response-complete process events with attempt, schema, token-budget, response-size, and stream-chunk metrics.
Blueprint compiler logs now show plan/start/compiled order, config feature ids, compile duration, item counts, enrichment source, and avoided provider-call count.
The v0.15.84 UX Design audit follow-up keeps export notes simple, recovers from local conversation quota pressure, and quarantines UX source-finder false friends.

carryForward.next: After deploy, run a fresh v0.15.85 EduTool.dev ZIP/log audit and confirm ordinary saved console logs include provider request/response and compiler trace rows.

The supplied v0.15.84 UX package exported 99/A but patched local regrade is 93/A with six P1 source false-friend findings and texture 93, so fresh v0.15.85 evidence must verify source quarantine first.
